name: affirm-test-ts-parser
description: Test-only: typescript-eslint's parser with TypeScript 5.9. The repo itself uses TypeScript 7, which has no JS API for the parser to call. This is a separate npm project with its own lockfile, installed by the root `prepare` script, so the parser and everything it loads (including `ts-api-utils`) resolve `typescript` to 5.9, never to the root's 7.
